theme: Speak to Agents: The New Language of Brand Visibility

rounds.title: Online Assessment (MCQ + Coding)

rounds.quote: In this round, participants are required to attempt a 1-hour online assessment comprising 15 multiple-choice questions (15 minutes), 2 coding challenges (45 minutes). The team's final score will be calculated based on the average score of all its members.

rounds.title: Case Study on Brand Visibility
rounds.window: 16 Aug 26, 12:00 PM IST → 16 Aug 26, 04:00 PM IST · 45 minutes, one attempt
rounds.quote: Shortlisted participants from the Online Assessment Round will advance to this round. Participants will be required to analyse a real-world brand visibility case study and answer a set of questions based on the given scenario. Responses will be evaluated on analytical thinking, strategic approach, and the ability to derive actionable insights. This round must be completed within 45 minutes in one sitting before the timer expires. Each participant is allowed only one attempt.

rulesBrief:
**Read the official Assessment Guidelines before anything else — Round 1 is not a normal exam.** Three rules decide your score:

**1. You cannot go back.** *"You won't be able to browse through the questions. If you either skip your question or submit your answer, it is marked and stored, and cannot be altered."* There is no palette, no review, no changing your mind.

**2. You must submit every answer individually.** *"Otherwise your response will NOT be recorded."* Selecting an option is not submitting it.

**3. Speed is marked separately from accuracy.** The official worked example: a 4-mark question with a 120-second timer, answered correctly in 30 seconds, scores **2 for accuracy and 1.5 for speed = 3.5**, because 75% of the time remained. Every second you sit on a question you have already solved costs marks.

**The numbers.** 17 questions, 01:00:00 total, **00:01:00 per question**, auto-advance when a question's time runs out. Window is 09 Aug 02:00 PM → 10 Aug 02:00 PM IST, but you must **start by 10 Aug 02:00 PM** to get the full hour. Once started, the timer does not stop.

**Sections.** Switchable from a section tab above the questions. Once a section's time is over you cannot answer any more of its questions.

**Your team score is the average of every member's score**, so the weakest member is where the cheapest marks are.

**Proctoring is strict.** SmartHire app only, desktop or laptop only, fullscreen mandatory, webcam and mic required with constant audio monitoring, no external displays, no screen sharing, and no WhatsApp / Discord / Chrome / ChatGPT open — that causes an automatic exit. Do not rest your hand on your face; it can trigger a "mobile phone detected" violation.

> Quotes and timings are taken from the official Unstop listing and its Assessment Guidelines, read on 09 Aug 2026. Re-check on the day — organisers do change them.
